notes.title: New Update (ver 1.4.8)
notes.content:
For the past month, I've been working hard on building an actual save system for Athemore. It has definitely been a challenge, but also a fun experience for me to work on. 



Patch notes: 

Added the long waited save system. It's now possible to save your progress manually into predefined save slots or using a quick save shortcut (F5). Furthermore the game now auto saves at checkpoints.

When you die, you don't automatically respawn anymore. Instead you get to chose on which save game you want to load. This also means that any progression made passed the recent save wont be saved.

The Game Settings Menu panels now auto-saves any applied settings. It's also possible to restore the settings back to default. 

Fixed a bug where the platform puzzle didn't register the correct tile being pressed within the sequence. 

Fixed some minor bugs across the board.  



The next task will be for me to improve the visuals of the Game Menu and add better looking artwork for the UI components such as the Journal and Inventory. Likewise I want to do something about the Steam images as well. 

In addition I want to add some sound effects when players interact with the UI buttons.

notes.title: New Update (ver 1.4.1)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're excited to announce the latest developments in Athemore!

 Localization Expansion: The long-awaited localization system has been successfully implemented, bringing support for Russian and German languages to Athemore. Stay tuned as we plan to introduce additional languages in the near future.
 Codebase Overhaul: Over the past five months, we’ve been revamping the entire codebase of the game, ensuring smoother performance and enhanced gameplay experiences.

Moving forward, we have identified key areas for improvement in the near future:

 Optimizing Lighting: Currently, the game renders all lights regardless of player’s view cone, resulting in performance issues. We're actively working on implementing a solution to cull unnecessary lights, which will significantly improve performance and reduce stuttering.
 Dungeon Illumination: Regarding the darkness of the Dungeon, we're dedicated to enhancing the Dungeon experience by adjusting lighting to achieve optimal visibility without compromising atmosphere.
 Game Menu Redesign: Recognizing the need for a more engaging and visually appealing interface, we're committed to revamping the Game Menu to provide a seamless and immersive user experience.

Patch notes: 

 Optimized the new fall damage system. which hopefully eliminates all previous fall damage glitches.
 Added localization support for Russian & German. (Thanks to: Eketarina & Robin)
 Added the missing “Apply” button for applying the screen resolution. 
 Added a “Reset to default” button that resets the associated settings.
 The Inventory UI color transparency has been removed.  
 Improved the subtitle UI.
 Optimized the Input system.
 Code Optimization.
 Fixed an issue where certain items didn’t actually fall to the ground if they were dropped from inventory.

notes.title: New Update (ver 1.4.0)
notes.content:
Hello all,
During the last month, I’ve been working hard on improving the codebase in Athemore. It took way longer than expected, but now it’s finally functional. 
The revamp was mainly aimed for localization support, but since the original codebase was poorly written, I made a decision to wipe it all and start over. Doing this overhaul also flushed out some bugs, but unfortunately new unknown bugs might occur as well. I’ll do my best to keep an eye out for unwanted elements and then roll on hotfixes gradually if need be.  

All UI elements and scripts have been revamped as well. The game used to handle all UI logic within a single script, but now that script has been divided and spread out into multiple scripts instead, so that each script only handles its own logic. This is a way more efficient and it also saves some performance here and there.

Same goes for object interaction logic such as Puzzles, Items and NPCs. All interactions used to use a single script for every interactable object and then based on its name was able to find the correct function to initialize by comparing two strings. This was a really terrible solution and could easily end up doing some unwanted behaviors.

As for upcoming tasks, the game still lacks some polish here and there, but more importantly I need to find a smart way to cull every light source to prevent stuttering issues. Furthermore, I need to increase the overall lighting. It’s still too dark at the moment.
Finally, multiple languages will be implemented into the game as soon as possible.

Patch notes can be read here:

 Improved all UI elements in the game. The old version used several canvases. Now the game only uses one for all the UI. 
 Improved the Journal & the document reading system.
 Improved the Game Menu.
 Improved the Inventory.
 Support for ultra wide monitor resolutions
 Improved the way of interacting with objects work like with puzzles, items, NPC’s etc. 
 Added the functionality for Localization, so it will become easier to change language. Additional languages will be added eventually.
 Fixed an issue where the Player were able to die multiple times in a single death sequence.
 Fixed an issue where using items on objects caused didn’t respond properly.

The core thing around this update is the dialogue system. It has been revamped into a better system. The new dialogue system will also be able to handle the upcoming localization functionality better. The goal is to implement at least 7 additional languages in the near future.  
This update also includes the addition of some missing key features and some bug fixes. Patch notes is listed here:

 Improved the dialogue system. It should now be easier to implement the localization
 Revamped all Audrey’s voice lines. Big thanks to @Quiet for helping out.
 Within dialogues, the player is now unable to move. The player camera can still be controlled in some cases though.
 Interacting objects with Left Mouse click has been temporarily disabled, since it caused some issues when the inventory was active. 
 The game now indicates whenever the player takes minor damage, with both a visual and voice effect.  
 Added an Athemore icon on the executable file. 
 Fixed the issue where the “E” stayed on the screen in unwanted situations. 
 Fixed a bug where the light while reading documents was disabled.

notes.title: New Update (ver 1.3.0)
notes.content:
Hello all,
We finally have a new update ready!

The old first person controller (player) has been replaced with a newer and better working first person controller. 
Furthermore the old input system has been replaced as well. This makes it a lot easier for future implementation for various controller devices such as game pads, joysticks etc. Likewise, Athemore is now open for possible console releases as well.
In addition, we’ve added the possibility to rebind the controls within the game menu along with other option features, which can be read in the patch notes below.
We wanted to focus on finishing these important tasks as mentioned above, because we will definitely be benefiting from our upcoming game releases as well.

We still have plenty of upcoming tasks for this game in our scope such as:

 Do something about the complete darkness in the dungeon
 Add some sort of player damage taken indication, such as pain voices and a screen indication.
 Improve upon the overall AI
 Add support for multiple languages
 Fixing some minor issues



Patch notes for 1.3.0 (07-08-2022)


 Replaced the old input system with Unity’s newest input system. This opens up a lot of options which make it possible to support different devices such as game controllers and joysticks etc in the future.
 Replaced the old first person controller with a newer and more improved version
 Reinstalled a better working crouch function. 
 Added an option to rebind keys within the game menu.
 Added an option within the game menu to invert both the mouse X and Y axis.
 Added an option within the game menu to enable / disable the subtitles.
 Fixed an issue within the inventory, where any item tooltip not displaying as intended while hovering over items with the mouse cursor.
 Fixed a few graphical glitches.

Hello all!

It’s been a little while since the last devlog. We have been working hard on optimizing the backup structure for all our projects, so it’s way easier to work on separate branches based on the same game. 

There’s also some news for the upcoming period of time. 
First of all, Athemore has been approved for participating in the Game Development World Championship 2022.

Secondly, we’re going to begin implementing additional languages for Athemore in the near future.
Likewise, we’re continuing working on the remaining tasks from last time. This involved the overall lighting and the ability to change controls.

Finally, a couple of minor bugs have been addressed. The patch notes are listed below:


 Added a journal system to the game. This should help the player keep track and get a better overview of things.

notes.title: Plans for April (2022)
notes.content:
Based on the feedback we have received so far, we're definitely going to improve upon the game and add additional quality of life features as well.
All these improvements will be gradually implemented to the game, whenever they’re ready.

Our top priorities during April are listed below:


 The game is too dark
 Journal / Hint system
 The inputs/controls
 Player damage taken indication
 The overall AI


The game is too dark
Lots of players say it’s too dark and we agree. We’ll fix this eventually.
We have already been trying to achieve a decent lighting setting within the scene, but Unity really makes it hard for us to work with. Everytime we try to generate the lighting it always looks awful, and it also takes a very long time for the computer to process every time. 

Journal / Hint system
Some players seem to get confused about what to do in certain situations. We definitely don’t want to hold the player’s hand through the game, but we are willing to offer the player some help.
We are going to add a journal / hint solution to help the player keep track of everything useful intel the player might find.

The inputs/controls
We are going to make it possible to change the keyboard/mouse input keys as well make it possible to select inverted mouse within the game-settings.

Player damage taken indication
The player can easily die if he stands in the fire for too long. However there’s nothing that indicates he is taking damage, while standing there. Therefore we are going to add some pain voices as well as some red flashes on the screen.

The overall AI
We are aware that the enemies are way too broken and unfair. They are currently able to detect and grab the player through walls and that’s definitely not intended.
The NPC also has some issues whenever the NPC has to follow the player around. The NPC can easily get stuck on things. 
Therefore we are going to revamp the overall AI to behave more natural and fair.
We are going to make the AI’s vision become based on angles. Likewise we are going to make it harder for the enemies to detect the player if the player-torch is unlit.

notes.title: First Launch and Patch notes
notes.content:
Hello all!
This is my first game ever on Steam, so I hope it will be well received.

First of all, I’m sorry for the late post. I have been busy solving a lot of issues with the game after the release and also learning my way through all the Steam tools.

The release of Athemore didn’t go as smoothly as I was hoping for. I quickly ran into issues.
About a week earlier, I uploaded an older version of the game, the main reason for this was just to get Steam to verify it. This way, I could quicker overwrite it with the very recent version whenever it was ready to go. Unfortunately I messed up the whole Steam procedure about selecting the correct game to publish, because it all was very new to me. 
I know a few people bought and actually played the older version. Sorry about the confusion!

Below are the patch notes for the two updates on the “Steam version” of Athemore:

1.2.0(09-04-2022)

 Fixed some graphical glitches
 Fixed an issue with the blood bowl (Blood ritual) not showing the blood being poured. 
 The random sound effects are now paused while reading documents or while being in dialogue.
 Fixed the compass UI, so it behaves properly in different resolutions
 Added a Player Setting feature to toggle on/off the player torch model (the light still stays)
 Added a Player Setting feature to toggle on/off the Player-Headbob feature
 Added a text notification, everytime the player reaches a new checkpoint.
 Added a small tutorial at the beginning of the game
 Added an patrolling enemy into the prison area, which can spawn over time.
 Audrey (NPC) has been added to the game.
 Added voice acting for both Jerome and Audrey
 Added a new area, called the “Vault”
 Added more endings.
 Added a loading screen image
 Added more events, such as scares, puzzles etc. 
 Added Steam achievements
 It’s now possible to collect multiple of identical items. A drop function has been added as well for those types of items.
 Changed the usage of the inventory. It must now be used with the classic drag and drop system (Drag the item onto another item or object).
 Added game menu music to the game.
 Added more ingame readable documents. Small changes to parts of the existing documents as well.
 Revamped the drawing of the map. (Including making North being upwards)



1.2.1(12-04-2022)

 Fixed a game breaking bug caused by ghosts after grabbing the player’s camera not allowing it to reset properly. 
 Fixed an issue about displaced UI text in various screen-resolutions.
 Added a feature for the Stepstone puzzle which highlights the correct glyphs the player is standing on. 
 Reduced the overall loot value, to make it more fitting with the Steam achievements.
 Fixed an issue causing the player to die twice in a row after falling into the giant pit.
 Added a check-point just before the large broken bridge to the West
 Fixed an issue which caused the game to softlock after sitting in the throne putting on the crown.
 Fixed an issue caused by using the crown on the green flame, making the crown disappear. 
 Fixed a couple of voice misplacements.
